title: Enterprise Connectivity: invoice issuance
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs invoice issuance for service charge.

## Policy clause 1
No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

## Policy clause 2
Group service charges by invoice grouping.

## Policy clause 3
Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing calendar timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month.

## Policy clause 4
For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records.

## Policy clause 5
Set invoice issue time to the fixed current handling time.

## Policy clause 6
Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge.

## Policy clause 7
A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge.

## Policy clause 8
The fixed source reference and source classification distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Evidence condition 1
For service charge, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch, period, event type, status. Correlate the same source-event reference to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Source-component identity
Duplicate detection concerns a separate posted service-charge record for the same source, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch and billing month. A differing external reference does not change those source-component comparisons.

## Points of judgement
The fixed source reference and source classification distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the minimum invoice amount, invoice grouping, billing cycle, billing calendar timezone used by this rule.

## Record identity: service charge
A service invoice line increases the contract receivable. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch.
